## Course Description

Linear and multiple regression with an emphasis on real-world application.

**Topics include:**

- Simple and multiple linear regression
- Residual analysis and model diagnostics
- Transformations and variable selection
- Analysis of covariance
- Stepwise regression

---

## Learning Objectives {.smaller}

By the end of this course, you will be able to:

- Formulate, fit, and interpret simple and multiple linear regression models
- Conduct residual analysis and diagnose violations of model assumptions
- Identify and handle outliers, leverage points, and multicollinearity
- Apply transformations to linearize relationships and stabilize variance
- Implement variable selection methods
- Perform statistical inference and prediction in regression models
- Use R for exploratory data analysis, model fitting, and diagnostic plotting

## Attendance

**In-person attendance is crucial.** It allows you to engage in hands-on activities, ask questions in real time, and form connections with your peers and instructor.

**If you miss a class:**

- Be proactive — notify me before or within a day; no documentation required
- Work with me to review any missed material
- **Stay home when you are sick**

---

## Policy on Generative AI {.smaller}

AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) can be valuable for learning, but must be used responsibly. You are permitted to use AI for helping to understand statistical concepts or mathematical formulas, debugging your own code by asking why an error occurred or how to fix a specific line, or clarifying course material or lecture concepts. However, you are not permitted to use AI to write or complete assignments for you, generate code solutions, solve homework or exam problems, or use AI output without understanding what it does.

Uses of AI that do not follow the guidelines above will result in receiving a lower score on the assignment.
